basic_info.description: Located 1 block from the Embarcadero Waterfront, this corner unit offers an extensive sunlight throughout the day, two bedrooms, two full baths and Twin Peaks and SF skyline views. Unit 11J is highlighted by an expansive and elegant L shaped living and dining rooms complemented by a spacious lounge and reading area. A large primary bedroom with en suite bathroom includes a private balcony with Twin Peaks views, while the expansive windows in the second bedroom provide far-reaching and dramatic city views. Situated on opposite sides of the unit, the two bedrooms provide an unparalleled level of privacy. The Brannan is a full-service building offering 24-hr security, concierge services, professionally managed, amazing pool, jacuzzi and fitness center.
